findings.description: The enabled flag is checked only in decorator wrappers, so direct use of Retrying or AsyncRetrying still retries when enabled=False.
findings.rationale: For example, Retrying(enabled=False, stop=stop_after_attempt(3))(f), where f raises ValueError, still executes the unchanged retry loop and calls f three times. The same issue affects direct AsyncRetrying calls: the constructors accept the flag, but only wraps() honors it, so callers requesting disabled retries still observe repeated execution and retry error handling.
